system.description: Once per rest, when you make a successful Presence Roll or use an Influence card while being watched by a crowd, recorded, or streamed by a group, you can amplify the moment. Choose any number of creatures within Close range who can see or hear you. Allies clear 1 Stress. Adversaries must mark 1 Stress.
